turns.question: What was our ROAS in September 2026, counting the value of bookings against ad spend?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ROAS metric, so I can't give a ROAS figure; the closest metrics are Booking value (EUR) and Ad spend (EUR), which for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 were 128,900.00 EUR and 6,270.00 EUR. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
